episodes.title: Hur allt började
episodes.summary: Sofie's new job gets off to a rocky start when Max catches her doing something inappropriate at work, inadvertently starting a game of challenges.

episodes.title: Överraska mig
episodes.summary: Max's first challenge to Sofie entails Friedrich and Denise's predicament over a poorly written manuscript about director Ingmar Bergman.

episodes.title: StreamUs
episodes.summary: An inaccurate book-to-film adaptation sends Friedrich into a tailspin. The challenges — and the flirting — between Max and Sofie intensify.

episodes.title: Fast anställning
episodes.summary: Ronny and Sofie break important news to the team. Max dives into his quest to secure permanent employment at the publishing house.

episodes.title: Bokmässan
episodes.summary: One of Max and Sofie's challenges jeopardizes an important presentation at a book fair — and takes their relationship to the next level.

episodes.title: Ånger
episodes.summary: The team lands in hot water after the disastrous events at the book fair. A guilt-ridden Sofie starts ignoring Max, so he shows up at her house.

episodes.title: Ayahuasca
episodes.summary: Sofie's marriage takes a left turn. Max visits his family to fulfill a very personal challenge. A soul-searching Friedrich takes ayahuasca.

episodes.title: Nuet, evigheten och åtgärdspaketet
episodes.summary: A possible move to London causes Sofie to vent to Max. Meanwhile, the publishing house is hanging by a thread. Is this the end, or a new beginning?

episodes.title: Allt är annorlunda nu
episodes.summary: Sofie tackles a new position at Lund & Lagerstedt. After receiving shocking news, she comes to an abrupt decision about her relationship with Max.

episodes.title: Jägerstedt Publishing
episodes.summary: Friedrich's label gets its first author. Caroline visits Max in his new home. Sofie's friends introduce her to online dating.

episodes.title: Sensitivitetskonsulten
episodes.summary: Ronny hires a sensitivity consultant to appease a crisis at Lund & Lagerstedt. Caroline demands clarity from Max. Vivianne and Friedrich get closer.

episodes.title: Litteraturmördare!
episodes.summary: A protest against Sofie's new business model shakes the publishing house. Frederich learns a harsh truth. Sofie and Max rekindle their game of dares.

episodes.title: Författarkryssning
episodes.summary: The team attends an event on a cruise ship, where Denise ends up moderating Vivianne's talk. Caroline opens an Instagram account about Max's gardening.

episodes.title: Exorcism
episodes.summary: After his Instagram account earns a large following, Max gets offered a book deal. A challenge leads Sofie to start dealing with her grief and visions.

episodes.title: Vad är äkta och spelar det någon roll?
episodes.summary: Vivianne's final book chapter shocks and angers Denise. Sofie's indifference confuses Max. A betrayal sends Sofie over the edge.

episodes.title: Konsten, kärleken, kapitalismen och modet att förändra grundförutsättningarna för dessa
episodes.summary: The publishing agency becomes the spotlight of Stockholm's literary world. Doubtful of Sofie, Max gives her one final dare to test her feelings.
